  library(Seurat)

```{r}
atac <- loadArchRProject(path = "/home/rstudio/mnt_out/NK_project/ArchR_v20260203")
motif_name   <- "TBX21"          # name used in addMotifAnnotations
out_parquet  <- "base_GRN_NK_cells_from_snATAC_fetahu2023.parquet"
promoter_win <- 2000             # bp; peaks within +/- of a TSS count as promoter-linked
use_p2g      <- FALSE            # TRUE if you ran addGeneIntegrationMatrix + addPeak2GeneLinks
p2g_cor      <- 0.45             # correlation cutoff for Peak2Gene distal links
 
# Restore Arrow file paths to current mount point
atac@projectMetadata$outputDirectory <- paste0(params$out, "ArchR_v20260203")
atac@sampleColData$ArrowFiles <- paste0(
  params$out, "ArchR_v20260203/ArrowFiles/",
  basename(as.character(atac@sampleColData$ArrowFiles))
)

# Create clust_group column (cluster × group, e.g. "C1_control")
atac$clust_group <- paste0(
  as.character(atac$Clusters_res1), "_",
  as.character(atac$group)
)
atac$clust_group <- factor(atac$clust_group)

pkid <- function(gr) paste0(seqnames(gr), ":", start(gr), "-", end(gr))
 
## Ensure motif annotations exist
if (!(motif_name %in% names(atac@peakAnnotation))) {
  message("Adding JASPAR2020 motif annotations (one-time, can be slow)...")
  atac <- addMotifAnnotations(ArchRatac = atac, motifSet = "JASPAR2020",
                              name = motif_name, force = FALSE)
}
 
## Peak2gene links
ps <- getPeakSet(atac)
ps_id <- pkid(ps)
 
##  distal links via Peak2Gene (integrated scRNA-seq data)
p2g  <- getPeak2GeneLinks(atac, corCutOff = p2g_cor, returnLoops = FALSE)
pks  <- metadata(p2g)$peakSet
gns  <- metadata(p2g)$geneSet

links_p2g <- data.frame(peak_id          = pkid(pks)[p2g$idxATAC],
                        gene_short_name  = gns$name[p2g$idxRNA],
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
 
links_p2g <- links_p2g %>% filter(gene_short_name != "" & !is.na(gene_short_name)) %>% distinct()
message(sprintf("%d peak-gene links_p2g across %d genes",
                nrow(links_p2g), length(unique(links_p2g$gene_short_name))))
 
## 3. Motif matches: peaks x TF (0/1)
matches <- getMatches(atac, name = motif_name)      # SummarizedExperiment
mm <- assay(matches)                                 # peaks x motifs (sparse logical)
rownames(mm) <- pkid(rowRanges(matches))
colnames(mm) <- colnames(matches)                    # motif names like "TBX21_750"
 
## restrict to peaks we actually linked, to keep memory down
mm <- mm[intersect(rownames(mm), unique(links_p2g$peak_id)), , drop = FALSE]
 
## collapse motif columns to TF symbols (OR across a TF's multiple motifs)
tf_sym <- sub("_[0-9]+$", "", colnames(mm))
uniq_tf <- unique(tf_sym)
tf_mat <- vapply(uniq_tf, function(tf) {
  cols <- which(tf_sym == tf)
  as.integer(Matrix::rowSums(mm[, cols, drop = FALSE]) > 0)
}, integer(nrow(mm)))
rownames(tf_mat) <- rownames(mm)
tf_df <- as.data.frame(tf_mat) %>% rownames_to_column("peak_id")
 
## optional: keep only TFs that are measured genes in the RNA (cleaner for CellOracle)
# rna_genes <- rownames(GetAssayData(readRDS("nk_seurat.rds"), assay="RNA", layer="counts"))
# tf_df <- tf_df[, c("peak_id", intersect(colnames(tf_df)[-1], rna_genes))]
 
## 4. Assemble CellOracle base-GRN table ---------------------------
base_grn <- links_p2g %>%
  left_join(tf_df, by = "peak_id") %>%
  filter(if_any(-c(peak_id, gene_short_name), ~ !is.na(.)))   # drop peaks w/ no motif row
tf_cols  <- setdiff(colnames(base_grn), c("peak_id", "gene_short_name"))
base_grn[tf_cols][is.na(base_grn[tf_cols])] <- 0L
base_grn <- base_grn[, c("peak_id", "gene_short_name", tf_cols)]
 
message(sprintf("base GRN: %d rows, %d TF columns", nrow(base_grn), length(tf_cols)))
stopifnot("TBX21" %in% tf_cols)                       # sanity: T-bet motif present
 
## 5. Write for CellOracle-----------
write_parquet(base_grn, out_parquet)
message(sprintf("wrote %s -> set BASE_GRN_PARQUET in the Python sim script.", out_parquet))
 
## Next (single Python step): in in_silico_TBX21_perturbation.py set
##   BASE_GRN_PARQUET = "base_GRN_from_ATAC.parquet"  and run it.
 
```

# ___TBX21 - RUNX3 - CD6 axis___

```{r}
## ___Define TBX21 locus (incl. CNS-3 enhancer, 3kb upstream of TSS)___

# Get TBX21 coordinates from the project's gene annotation
gene_anno   <- getGeneAnnotation(atac)
tbx21_gene  <- gene_anno$genes[which(gene_anno$genes$symbol == "TBX21")]

if (length(tbx21_gene) == 0) {
  # Fallback: hg38 coordinates (chr17, plus strand)
  # Source: NCBI/UCSC via GeneCards, https://www.genecards.org/cgi-bin/carddisp.pl?gene=TBX21
  tbx21_gene <- GRanges("chr17", IRanges(47733236, 47746126), strand = "+",
                         symbol = "TBX21")
  cat("TBX21 gene annotation not found in project; using hg38 hardcoded coordinates.\n")
} else {
  cat("TBX21 gene:", as.character(seqnames(tbx21_gene)),
      start(tbx21_gene), "-", end(tbx21_gene),
      "strand:", as.character(strand(tbx21_gene)), "\n")
}

# TSS (respecting strand)
if (as.character(strand(tbx21_gene)) == "-") {
  tbx21_tss <- end(tbx21_gene)
} else {
  tbx21_tss <- start(tbx21_gene)
}

# Promoter: TSS +/- 2 kb (same convention as GSK3B)
tss_w <- 2000L
tbx21_promoter <- GRanges(
  seqnames = seqnames(tbx21_gene),
  ranges   = IRanges(tbx21_tss - tss_w, tbx21_tss + tss_w),
  strand   = strand(tbx21_gene)
)

# CNS-3 enhancer: ~3kb UPSTREAM of TSS (Fang et al., Immunity 2022,
# PII S1074-7613(22)00128-5 / DOI: 10.1016/j.immuni.2022.03.002).
# NOTE: CNS-3 was defined/validated in MOUSE Tbx21; this window projects the
# "-3kb from TSS" logic onto the human locus and is NOT a lifted-over,
# experimentally validated human coordinate. Treat as a candidate region.
# "Upstream" here = lower genomic coordinate because TBX21 is + strand in hg38.
enh_offset <- 3000L   # distance from TSS to enhancer center
enh_halfw  <- 1000L   # half-width of the window around that point (adjust if needed)

if (as.character(strand(tbx21_gene)) == "-") {
  tbx21_enh_center <- tbx21_tss + enh_offset
} else {
  tbx21_enh_center <- tbx21_tss - enh_offset
}

tbx21_enhancer <- GRanges(
  seqnames = seqnames(tbx21_gene),
  ranges   = IRanges(
    pmax(1L, tbx21_enh_center - enh_halfw),
    tbx21_enh_center + enh_halfw
  ),
  strand   = strand(tbx21_gene)
)

# Extended locus for browser track: gene body + generous flanks so the
# CNS-3 enhancer (upstream) is comfortably inside the view
tbx21_locus <- GRanges(
  seqnames = seqnames(tbx21_gene),
  ranges   = IRanges(
    pmax(1L, min(start(tbx21_gene), start(tbx21_enhancer)) - 3000L),
    max(end(tbx21_gene), end(tbx21_enhancer)) + 3000L
  )
)

cat("TBX21 promoter (TSS +/-2kb):",
    as.character(seqnames(tbx21_promoter)),
    start(tbx21_promoter), "-", end(tbx21_promoter), "\n")
cat("TBX21 CNS-3 enhancer (~TSS -3kb, +/-1kb):",
    as.character(seqnames(tbx21_enhancer)),
    start(tbx21_enhancer), "-", end(tbx21_enhancer), "\n")
cat("TBX21 locus (view window):",
    as.character(seqnames(tbx21_locus)),
    start(tbx21_locus), "-", end(tbx21_locus), "\n")
```

## ___Peak accessibility at TBX21 promoter, CNS-3 enhancer, and gene body___

```{r}
peak_se <- getMatrixFromProject(atac, useMatrix = "PeakMatrix")

# Peaks overlapping TBX21 gene body OR promoter OR CNS-3 enhancer
tbx21_query <- c(tbx21_gene, tbx21_promoter, tbx21_enhancer)
peak_gr     <- getPeakSet(atac)
ov_hits     <- findOverlaps(peak_gr, tbx21_query, ignore.strand = TRUE)
tbx21_peak_idx <- unique(queryHits(ov_hits))

cat("Peaks overlapping TBX21 locus (gene + promoter + CNS-3 enhancer):",
    length(tbx21_peak_idx), "\n")
if (length(tbx21_peak_idx) == 0) {
  cat("WARNING: No peaks found at TBX21 locus. Check chromosome naming.\n")
}
```

```{r}
if (length(tbx21_peak_idx) > 0) {
  acc_mat <- assay(peak_se, "PeakMatrix")[tbx21_peak_idx, , drop = FALSE]

  is_promoter <- tbx21_peak_idx %in% queryHits(findOverlaps(
    peak_gr, tbx21_promoter, ignore.strand = TRUE
  ))
  is_enhancer <- tbx21_peak_idx %in% queryHits(findOverlaps(
    peak_gr, tbx21_enhancer, ignore.strand = TRUE
  ))
  is_genebody <- tbx21_peak_idx %in% queryHits(findOverlaps(
    peak_gr, tbx21_gene, ignore.strand = TRUE
  ))

  cat("Promoter peaks:", sum(is_promoter), "\n")
  cat("CNS-3 enhancer peaks:", sum(is_enhancer), "\n")
  cat("Gene body peaks:", sum(is_genebody), "\n")

  cell_acc <- data.frame(
    cell       = colnames(acc_mat),
    acc_all    = colSums(acc_mat),
    acc_promo  = if (any(is_promoter)) colSums(acc_mat[is_promoter, , drop = FALSE]) else 0,
    acc_enh    = if (any(is_enhancer)) colSums(acc_mat[is_enhancer, , drop = FALSE]) else 0,
    acc_body   = if (any(is_genebody)) colSums(acc_mat[is_genebody, , drop = FALSE]) else 0
  )

  cell_df_tbx <- data.frame(
    Clusters_res1 = as.character(atac$Clusters_res1),
    group         = as.character(atac$group),
    cell          = getCellNames(atac),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  cell_df_tbx <- left_join(cell_df_tbx, cell_acc, by = "cell") %>%
    mutate(
      Clusters_res1 = factor(Clusters_res1, levels = CLUSTER_ORDER),
      group         = factor(group, levels = GROUP_ORDER)
    )

  head(cell_df_tbx)
}
```

## ___Pseudobulk accessibility at TBX21 per cluster x group___

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
if (exists("cell_df_tbx") && nrow(cell_df_tbx) > 0 && !all(cell_df_tbx$acc_all == 0)) {

  pb_tbx <- cell_df_tbx %>%
    group_by(Clusters_res1, group) %>%
    summarise(
      n_cells    = n(),
      mean_all   = mean(acc_all,   na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_promo = mean(acc_promo, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_enh   = mean(acc_enh,   na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_body  = mean(acc_body,  na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n_cells >= 5)

  pb_long <- pb_tbx %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(mean_promo, mean_enh, mean_body),
                 names_to = "region", values_to = "accessibility") %>%
    mutate(region = recode(region,
                           mean_promo = "TBX21 promoter (TSS +/-2kb)",
                           mean_enh   = "TBX21 CNS-3 enhancer (~TSS -3kb)",
                           mean_body  = "TBX21 gene body"))

  p_pb <- ggplot(pb_long, aes(x = Clusters_res1, y = accessibility, fill = group)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~ region, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = COLOR_CODE_perGROUP) +
    labs(
      title    = "TBX21 chromatin accessibility per ATAC cluster",
      subtitle = "Pseudobulk mean (cells >=5 per clust_group)",
      x        = "ATAC cluster", y = "mean accessibility", fill = "genetic group"
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "top")

  p_pb
  pdf(paste0(params$out, "figures/snATAC_NK_TBX21_pseudobulk_accessibility.pdf"),
      height = 8, width = 10, useDingbats = FALSE)
  p_pb; dev.off()
}
```

## ___Wilcoxon tests: ATRXdel vs control per cluster___

```{r}
if (exists("cell_df_tbx")) {
  regions_stat <- c(
    "TBX21 promoter"      = "acc_promo",
    "TBX21 CNS-3 enhancer" = "acc_enh",
    "TBX21 gene body"     = "acc_body"
  )

  stat_results <- bind_rows(lapply(names(regions_stat), function(rl) {
    col_nm <- regions_stat[[rl]]
    bind_rows(lapply(CLUSTER_ORDER, function(cl) {
      sub_df <- cell_df_tbx %>% filter(Clusters_res1 == cl)
      bind_rows(lapply(
        list(c("ATRXdel", "control"),
             c("ATRXdel", "MYCNamp"),
             c("ATRXdel", "ATRXwtMYCNwt"),
             c("MYCNamp", "control")),
        function(grp_pair) {
          g1 <- sub_df %>% filter(group == grp_pair[1]) %>% pull(col_nm)
          g2 <- sub_df %>% filter(group == grp_pair[2]) %>% pull(col_nm)
          if (length(g1) < 5 || length(g2) < 5) return(NULL)
          wt <- wilcox.test(g1, g2)
          data.frame(
            region    = rl,
            cluster   = cl,
            group1    = grp_pair[1],
            group2    = grp_pair[2],
            n1        = length(g1),
            n2        = length(g2),
            median1   = median(g1),
            median2   = median(g2),
            p_value   = wt$p.value,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
        }
      ))
    }))
  }))

  stat_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(stat_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  stat_results$sig   <- stat_results$p_adj < 0.05
  stat_results <- stat_results %>%
    arrange(region, cluster, p_adj) %>%
    mutate(across(c(p_value, p_adj), ~signif(.x, 3)))

  cat("TBX21 accessibility — Wilcoxon tests (BH-adjusted):\n")
  print(stat_results)

  write.csv(stat_results,
            paste0(params$out, "tables/snATAC_NK_TBX21_accessibility_wilcoxon.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## ___Peak-level accessibility heatmap at TBX21___

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
if (exists("cell_df_tbx") && length(tbx21_peak_idx) > 0) {
  cg_levels <- levels(atac$clust_group)
  cell_cg        <- as.character(atac$clust_group)
  names(cell_cg) <- getCellNames(atac)

  pb_peak_mat <- vapply(cg_levels, function(cg) {
    cells <- names(cell_cg)[cell_cg == cg]
    cells <- cells[cells %in% colnames(acc_mat)]
    if (length(cells) < 5) return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(acc_mat)))
    rowMeans(acc_mat[, cells, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  }, numeric(nrow(acc_mat)))

  # Row annotation: promoter vs CNS-3 enhancer vs gene body
  peak_region <- ifelse(is_promoter, "promoter",
                  ifelse(is_enhancer, "CNS-3 enhancer",
                  ifelse(is_genebody, "gene body", "other")))
  row_ha <- rowAnnotation(
    region = peak_region,
    col    = list(region = c("promoter" = "#D62728", "CNS-3 enhancer" = "#2CA02C",
                             "gene body" = "#1F77B4", "other" = "gray80")),
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
  )

  col_ann_pk <- data.frame(
    cluster   = sub("_.*", "", colnames(pb_peak_mat)),
    group     = sub("^[^_]+_", "", colnames(pb_peak_mat)),
    row.names = colnames(pb_peak_mat)
  )
  ha_pk <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    cluster = col_ann_pk$cluster,
    group   = col_ann_pk$group,
    col     = list(
      cluster = COL_ATAC_CLUSTER[unique(col_ann_pk$cluster)],
      group   = COLOR_CODE_perGROUP[unique(col_ann_pk$group)]
    ),
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
  )

  pb_peak_z <- t(scale(t(pb_peak_mat)))
  pb_peak_z[is.nan(pb_peak_z)] <- 0
  pb_peak_z[pb_peak_z >  2]   <-  2
  pb_peak_z[pb_peak_z < -2]   <- -2

  ht_peak <- Heatmap(
    pb_peak_z,
    name              = "accessibility\n(z-score)",
    top_annotation    = ha_pk,
    left_annotation   = row_ha,
    row_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    column_names_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    col               = colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")),
    cluster_rows      = TRUE,
    cluster_columns   = FALSE,
    column_split      = col_ann_pk$cluster,
    border            = TRUE,
    column_title      = "TBX21 peak accessibility: 7 clusters x genetic groups",
    column_title_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
    show_row_names    = nrow(pb_peak_z) <= 50
  )
  draw(ht_peak)
  pdf(paste0(params$out, "figures/snATAC_NK_TBX21_peak_accessibility_heatmap.pdf"),
      height = 5, width = 8, useDingbats = FALSE)
  draw(ht_peak); dev.off()
}
```
